memorybrain.description: MemoryBrain (memorybrain.ai) is a personal memory you own, served as a remote MCP connector: your AI can save notes, search them and read them back, and every note keeps its source (something you read, a chat or something you said). It is one memory shared across AI clients, and you can see, revoke and download everything from your account. Remote, OAuth sign-in with your email and a 6-digit code, nothing to install. In open beta; tested with ChatGPT (web) and Claude (web and iPhone app), other clients untested.
